executive_summary.conclusion: Standard Ebooks presents a clear, crawlable public-library task: the homepage explains the volunteer-produced, free public-domain offer, the rendered library exposes filtering and sorting, and a representative title page gives format guidance, copyright caveats, provenance, and contribution paths. The main coverage limit is that the browser client blocked the offered read-online destination, so online reading continuity was not verified; actual assistant visibility was not measured.

not_checked: Read-online /text was offered but browser returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT; no ebook files or full book text were downloaded.
Keyboard focus, mobile layout, contrast, overlays and form behavior were not systematically tested.
No assistant answer/citation runs, provider ranking, real crawler IP access, Search Console or behavioral analytics were measured.
Search baseline was bounded web retrieval only; no universal ranking or citation claim is made.
No donation, newsletter submission, account, personal data, purchase or authentication was attempted.

readiness.detail: robots.txt retrieved; named search and training agents allowed, while /ebooks/*/downloads/* and /ebooks/*/text* were disallowed only for listed user-agent groups. Local fetch does not prove provider access.
Static and rendered evidence exposed the offer, library controls, title metadata, formats, provenance and next-step links; one read-online destination was browser-blocked.
Five site-specific questions were tested against relevant first-party pages; four answered and online-reading destination explicitly partial.
Exact-entity and neutral retrieval returned consistent first-party identity plus GitHub/Wikipedia references; this is retrieval evidence, not an assistant citation test.
Two safe journeys traced through homepage, library, non-default popularity sort and representative title. The title page exposed a read-online handoff, but browser blocked its destination.

intent_tests.question: What does Standard Ebooks offer, and who is it for?

evidence.quote: Standard Ebooks is a volunteer-driven project that produces new editions of public domain ebooks ... open source ... and free of cost.
a collection of high quality, carefully formatted, accessible, open source, and free public domain ebooks

intent_tests.reason: Homepage and About page state offer, audience framing, cost and production context directly.

intent_tests.question: What legal or geographic restriction should a reader know before using a title?

evidence.quote: This ebook is thought to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. It may still be under copyright in other countries.

intent_tests.reason: Representative title page gives the qualification and directs non-U.S. readers to check local law.

intent_tests.question: How can a reader choose a title and format?

evidence.quote: Subjects ... Keywords ... Sort ... View ... Per page
Compatible epub ... azw3 ... kepub ... Advanced epub

intent_tests.reason: Rendered library controls and title format explanations cover discovery and device selection.

intent_tests.question: What evidence supports the quality/accessibility claims?

evidence.quote: fully proofread and corrects them ... professional-grade style manual
semantic XHTML ... alternative text ... WCAG 2.2 level AA and EPUB Accessibility 1.1
A BRIEF HISTORY OF THIS EBOOK

intent_tests.reason: Homepage, accessibility page and title history provide process, accessibility and provenance evidence.

intent_tests.question: Can a reader continue into an online reading view from the title page?

evidence.quote: Read online ... Start from the table of contents

intent_tests.reason: Action and destination URL were visible, but /text was browser-blocked, so destination content remains unverified rather than a site defect.

journeys.task: Understand the offer, browse the catalog, and reach a concrete title
journeys.starting_context: Rendered homepage with hero description and Browse our library link.

steps.action: Read hero and follow EBOOKS/Browse our library
steps.observation: Homepage described volunteer-produced, public-domain, free/open-source editions and exposed library path.

steps.action: Inspect library controls and title cards
steps.observation: Library rendered Subjects, Keywords, Sort, View, Per page, filter, pagination and title links.
Reached public detail page with summary, legal caveat, format choices, provenance and contribution links.

journeys.reason: Primary discovery-to-detail journey completed without submission or download.

journeys.task: Exercise a non-default catalog choice and inspect title handoff to online reading
journeys.starting_context: Rendered library defaulted to S.E. release date; popularity was selected as material alternative.

steps.action: Open Sort and select Popularity (most to least)
steps.observation: Control visibly changed to Popularity (most to least), confirming the non-default choice.

steps.action: Open title and inspect Read online choices
steps.observation: Title page offered Start from the table of contents and Read on one page, with format guidance and U.S. copyright caveat.
Browser client returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT; no claim made about destination content or choice retention.

journeys.reason: Non-default sort was observed, but read-online handoff could not be completed in this browser and was recorded as tooling limitation.

visibility.detail: No unbiased assistant answer runs with explicit citations were recorded. Web retrieval observations and on-site answerability are separate from actual assistant visibility.

proactive_opportunities.title: Verify and document the public read-online route across supported browsers
proactive_opportunities.rationale: Title page exposes a useful reading handoff, but this run could not observe /text because browser client blocked it. A repeatable browser-level check would distinguish client-specific block from a public continuity issue.
proactive_opportunities.mechanism: Check linked /text route in supported public browsers and preserve title context; document any intentional restriction or repair if reproducibly blocked.
proactive_opportunities.verification: From a fresh public browser session, open the title page, activate Start from the table of contents, and record a successful destination with title/TOC visible or an explicit documented restriction.
